data.text:
Families wait for rescue as hopes fade after deadly Cebu landfill collapse

Families of workers believed to be trapped at a landfill in Cebu City, the Philippines, say rescue efforts have been delayed, four days after a deadly landslide triggered a collapse on January 8. 
Relatives have been camping on higher ground near the dumpsite, waiting for updates, but report little visible progress. They say they heard trapped workers calling for help in the hours after the collapse, before the voices fell silent.
#Philippines #landfill #Cebu
